rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the place of torment believed to exist after death.

example.english: No one really knows whether there is hell after death.
example.traditional: 死後有冇地獄，真係冇人知。
example.jyutping: sei2 hau6 jau5 mou5 dei6 juk6 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 zi1

rows.note: Use 地獄 as the all-purpose noun for a hellish place or situation of suffering.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 dei6 juk6

rows.note: Use 折磨 when the thing is experienced as a severe torment, especially physical harm.

example.english: This headache is hell—it keeps me from sleeping.
example.traditional: 呢種頭痛真係折磨，搞到我瞓唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 tau4 tung3 zan1 hai6 zit3 mo4 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 dou2
